verdict.rationale: Postman documents CLI-driven collection runs that can be wired into CI/CD pipelines, webhooks for event-driven triggers, and a programmatic API for automating Postman assets, which together enable background automation, but this requires external CI/CD or scripting rather than a native scheduled 'run autonomously' feature and there is no mention of an autonomous monitor/scheduler product capability in the pack. missing for 10: dedicated always-on scheduled automation feature (e.g., monitors) explicitly documented, independent/hands-on evidence of unattended background execution, and evidence of AI-agent-driven autonomous triggering rather than manual CI wiring.
